name: Move Email data to Snowflake
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Email** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Snowflake data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **Email** account**.** Read more about the process [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/miscellaneous/email/setup.html).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/email) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
